text.p: Riddell Sports Inc said Wednesday that it has a memorandum of understanding for the settlement of legal actions which will require it to pay about $2.1 million.

Riddell said that as part of the proposed settlement the bankruptcy trustees and others who have initiated certain fraudulent transfer actions against the company are releasing the company from liability.
The proposed settlement also releases the company from all claims and counterclaims in an action involving a former employee, it said.
The $2.1 million consists of $1.4 million for which the company has previously established a reserve and about $700,000 which the company previously deposited into escrow and expensed.
The proposed settlement also requires the company to assign up to $3 million of royalties from its "Riddell" footwear licensee over a period of up to 10 years.
